notes.title: Fixed flicker problem
notes.content: Fixed a bug in which the game effects were flickering due to wrong vsync settings.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
Bug fixes :

1-the combo text doesn't animate onto the screen after the 2nd time
2-Wrong leaderboard appears when in no aiming mode

New features : 

1-Add the level progress on the top right

notes.title: New mode for casual players
notes.content:
Changes in this build :

1-Added a new mode for casual players to play with the mouse only
2-Added a separate leaderboard for players who play without aiming
3-You can now press Space or RB to toggle the helper buttons UI over the enemies

notes.title: Fixed calibration system
notes.content: Players were facing a problem in which they found themselves stuck in a black screen when they accessed the calibration mode to adjust for the sound delay, this is fixed with this new update.

notes.title: New level is here
notes.content:
Hello Players & Fans,

We would love to announce today that we released a new level called "Holy Desert", this track is a mix of oriental and techno and it's currently set as level 2.

We heard your voices and we knew the visual effects were too much for some of you, although you could turn it from the options it wasn't the best solution, now while playing the game you can now control every effect making it suitable for all players.

The following fixes were done : 

1-You can now change the visuals while playing in the game if you found it to be too much or if you want to make it stronger by using your scrollbar in the mouse or page up and page down buttons
2-Now when you change the button for the enemy for the gamepad its color in the game changes


Write down if you have any suggestions, and also please review the game if you like it.

Stay tuned for more updates soon.

notes.title: Hotfix for a critical bug
notes.content: We found a bug that happens when the last enemy in the song hits you, it results in you losing immediately, this is a hotfix for this issue

notes.title: Endless mix it mode is finally here
notes.content:
Hello Players,

We have made an update today in which you can access Mix it mode.

Mix it mode is an endless mode that will allow you to play the game endlessly in an arcade mode with the songs shuffled randomly, and featuring many powerups, and at the end there is a leaderboard in which you can compete to be among the first 30 players.

We released the techno version only for now with both modes normal and deathmatch (no health regeneration), each mode has its own leaderboards.

To access this mode you have to pass at least 5 levels.

In the next event we will be releasing a new level with a new track, so stay tuned and have fun.

Also pleasre write to us if you have any comments/suggestions.

notes.title: Endless mode is now live
notes.content:
Hello Players,

We have made an update today in which you can access Mix it mode.

Mix it mode is an endless mode that will allow you to play the game endlessly in an arcade mode with the songs shuffled randomly, and featuring many powerups, and at the end there is a leaderboard in which you can compete to be among the first 30 players.

We released the techno version only for now, and in the next 2 weeks we will release the deathmatch techno mode, it is the same endless mode but with no health regeneration, each mode has its own leaderboards.

To access this mode you have to pass at least 5 levels.

Have fun, and write to us if you have any comments/suggestions.

notes.title: hotfix patch 0.78.3 : "leaderboard fix"
notes.content: Leaderboard was not working after the latest update we needed to fix it.

notes.title: level 2 and level 6 had to be tweaked to be more playable
notes.content: Both level 2 and level 6 had very hard parts to play especially on Hard difficulty, this had to be tweaked to make them more playable

notes.title: Free Game Demo is here
notes.content:
For new players who would like to try our game but still not sure if it's the right type game for them, we have released a demo.

and since also it's the winter sale we will be participating in it so you will have a chance to get the game with a lowered price.

Not only that : we will be pushing the next update on January which will include the first part of our Mix It Mode featuring techno music, you will be able to play the game with all the game levels shuffled and submit your highscore along with powerups and new playing strategies.

So Stay Tuned, And Happy Christmas :)

notes.title: Game is now more suitable for new players
notes.content:
Some new players were finding hard time accommodating to the game difficulty.

So in the new update you will find :

1-Levels are re-ordered to suit new players more.
2-Levels difficulty has been redesign for the same purpose.
3-Better reaction to the player input.

And for the next update :

[b]Techno endless mode[/b] will be released, in this mode player will be able to play endlessly the techno levels shuffled, so stay tuned ;).

notes.title: Final Level Released : The Kingdom
notes.content:
Hello Players & Fans,

We would like to announce today that we finally released the final boss level, we know it took us too much time to develop it, but that's because we crafted every second to create a magnificent audio visualization so that it suits your high standards 

[previewyoutube=StamIU6ZzmA;full][/previewyoutube]

The track is a rhapsody containing 4 genres in one track with 9 minutes of gameplay, so get ready to finish what you already started ! 

In addition to that 8 new achievements can now be obtained.

notes.title: Christmas sale along with major fixes to the audio calibration option.

We did an update today to fix the following issues :

notes.content:
Hello Players & Fans,

We would like to announce today that we are very close to finishing the last level, you can expect it to be coming to the store as an update in the next few weeks, and till then we will leave you with this short clip showing what we achieved till now (WIP) :

notes.title: New mode for casual players along with major enhancements
notes.content:
Hello Player & Fans,

We updated the game today with the following :

1- Added "No Aiming mode", you can now play the game without aiming, this mode is for casual players.

2-Fixed an issue regarding the notes hitting points was not consistent among the levels.

3-It's easier now to spot the "Perfect" hit point.

4-Visual effects can now be controlled and totally turned off from the options.

We are always hearing from you, most of the updates are based on your opinions and reviews, next update will be regarding the last level of the game, please stay tuned.

Best Regards,
Aly Ameen
Beats OF Fury Team

notes.title: Fixing the rhythm
notes.content:
Hello Player & Fans,

We got some reviews and criticism regarding a delay that happens between pressing the button and the game sound feedback.

We worked on that and we updated the game today, you will feel now the rhythm more, please try the game again and tell us your feedback.

Also in case you are using a Buetooth speaker or in case you are still encountering delay, you will need to calibrate, there's a calibration mode in the options menu, that should fix any remaining delay.

Please write in the forum if there's some levels or some parts of levels that are still not perfect and we will immediately fix it.

Dont forget that the game is still in EA and we still need your valuable feedback to make it perfect.
